name: Continuity
description: Private story bible for fiction writers. Stores characters, relationships, world rules, timelines, and approved scenes so an AI assistant reads established canon before it writes and keeps people, places, timelines, and plot facts consistent. Tools: list_story_projects, create_story_project, get_continuity_context, search_story_canon, upsert_canon_entry, get_canon_history, list_approved_scenes, record_approved_scene, save_story_checkpoint, list_story_checkpoints, continuity_audit. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires a Continuity account. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/continuity. Made by Ouroboros (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
